summary.description: Trifluralin is an orange crystalline herbicide with no odour that evaporates easily and produces toxic fumes when heated.
emission_sources: Use as a pesticide in agricultural practices
environmental_impact: Harmful to wildlife, especially aquatic organisms
Binds to soil but is broken down by plants and animals
Degrades quickly in air and water when exposed to sunlight

top_sdg_impacts.SDG12_Responsible_Consumption_and_Produc: Trifluralin use in agriculture highlights the need for responsible management of chemical inputs to reduce environmental contamination.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG14_Life_Below_Water: Trifluralin is toxic to aquatic life, particularly sensitive species, making it a threat to aquatic ecosystems.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG6_Clean_Water_and_Sanitation: Due to runoff from agricultural fields, trifluralin can contaminate surface waters, affecting water quality and ecosystem health.
